opportunities.target: Bounded mutual information controls robust unilocal broadcasting-to-EB reconstruction in actual joint trace norm, uniformly in both finite dimensions.

exact_claim.quantifiers: For every finite B, every density sigma_B and every full-domain CPTP C:B->B_1 tensor B_2, there exists one full-domain EB CPTP Lambda_B depending only on C,sigma_B and preserving sigma_B. For every finite quantum reference A and every rho_AB with rho_B=sigma_B, the stated bound uses that state's actual I(A:B) and joint broadcasting error.
exact_claim.information: I=D(rho_AB || rho_A tensor sigma_B), natural logarithms
exact_claim.bound: For 0<b<1, e<=min(1,6*sqrt((I+1)/ln(1/b))). The same fixed map gives e=0 at b=0; I=0 states are fixed exactly.
exact_claim.scope: Finite-dimensional quantum references and systems; arbitrary singular marginal handled by support compression and full-domain EB extension. No minimum eigenvalue assumption.

opportunities.mechanism: Actual output-local gentle repair makes the common marginal sigma-stationary with joint error O(sqrt(b)); physical sigma-Petz composition gives a compatible KMS-reversible S with coordinate map V*V. The weighted common EB comparison supplies one physical sigma-preserving positive comparator L with I-L<=8(I-Re V). The product-reference quadratic metric amplifies this order to any quantum A. A substate-capped analytical comparison orbit has EB error squared bounded by quadratic-energy decay, while the original physical orbit moves at speed <=b_0. Comparing two orbits removes the need for compatible smoothing and yields the explicit logarithmic modulus.

load_bearing_gate.statement: For every faithful sigma and sigma-preserving actual selfcompatible CPTP S with KMS-self-adjoint Heisenberg adjoint H, one physical sigma-preserving pure-ensemble EB Psi has KMS-positive self-adjoint contraction K=Psi* with K>=(2H^2-I)_+ and hence I-K<=4(I-H).

compatibility_obligations: C is an actual full-domain physical broadcaster; symmetric state extensions do not suffice.
Both original joint marginal errors use the untouched quantum reference A and HALF trace norm.
Marginal repair preserves every extension of nu, not only the B marginal itself.
Petz map is physical CP/TP and sigma-preserving after faithful support compression.
Weighted comparison is genuine KMS operator order with one positive physical EB comparator, not a statewise or GNS estimate.
Product metric conjugation, rather than unjustified commutation with sigma, gives reference amplification.
The same EB map is chosen before A,rho,epsilon and orbit time; the substate comparison need not preserve sigma.
The JN fidelity convention is squared fidelity and its logarithms are converted from bits to nats.
early_falsifiers: Find a full-domain actual local broadcaster with b tending to zero at bounded I but fixed joint EB-distance witness.
Check the noncommuting repair on entangled extensions, including singular nu, rather than only stationarity.
Check V*V Petz factorization and product metric identities on genuinely nonunital HS-asymmetric maps.

The antisymmetric rho_- has I<=ln4 and many permutation-symmetric state extensions, e_EB=1/2, but actual local broadcasting optimum exactly 1/4. It falsifies the extension substitute, not the actual-channel theorem.
Directed cyclic unital maps approach the nonreversible entropy/root-energy constant 2, ruling out reuse of the reversible constant 4 in the tracial power route.
corollaries: Optimal actual broadcasting disturbance beta and optimal local EB disturbance epsilon satisfy beta<=epsilon<=min(1,6*sqrt((I+1)/ln(1/beta))), with epsilon=0 at beta=0.
The fixed EB measurement/preparation pipeline gives an actual classical mediator X with I(A:B|X)=0, exact original A and B marginals, AB trace reconstruction <=g, and I(A:X)<=I(A:B)_rho.
For tracial B marginal, a separately frozen stronger bound is e^3<=54*I*min(1,b+sqrt(2b-b^2)); if the common original marginal already preserves tau_B, e^3<=54*I*b.
opportunities.historical_importance: Quantitative reference-preserving converse to exact unilocal no-broadcasting under an information budget. It relates two operational disturbances uniformly in finite dimensions, without the all-priors capacity assumption required by a state-family transfer.
